datePolicy: All source access dates are explicitly assigned by the original sources.md ledger to 2026-11-05, including qualified indexed/limited-access observations; they are not successful live-price confirmations or new localization checks. Hotel sample dates retain their exposed precision and uncertainty. Future stay is 2027-04-15 through 2027-04-18; November observations are not future availability.
uncertainties: Published temporary K-ETA exemption ends 2026-12-31 KST; April 2027 requires recheck. No extension is established or ruled out.
Exact-date hotel inventory, tax-inclusive rates and cancellation terms not established. L7 is an undated indexed sample, not a reproduced live quote.
Blossom dates derive from a 2026 forecast, not a 2027 prediction. Weather, trail access, palace operations and vendor availability require rechecks.
US$1 = ₩1,400 is an assumed planning conversion. Future-trip costs and route durations are estimates, not quotes or verified future timetables.

Original full-page and viewport screenshot attempts timed out. Original lightweight DOM/layout check is not screenshot inspection. Separate package-local rendering evidence is recorded in checks/browser-batch9-spot-checks.json and checks/batch9-final-receipt.json; it does not revalidate external sources.
editingContract: Readable English and Simplified Chinese corresponding lines, paragraphs and table cells retain matching complete numeric, currency, date and external URL literals. Headline displays are complete visible semantic values, not substitution fragments. Local source links are relative to the original stage2-pages tree for builder rebasing.

audience.en: Two friends in their late twenties sharing a twin room for 3 nights on a first Seoul visit, April 15–18, 2027, travelling from Hong Kong on Hong Kong SAR passports with a US$1,200 cap excluding flights.
audience.zh: 两位二十多岁后半的朋友，持香港特区护照从香港出发，首次游首尔，2027年4月15–18日合住一间双床房3晚，预算上限US$1,200，不含机票。
